channel.title: The AI Artisan Notes
channel.description: Rethinking Software Standards in the Age of AI — Field notes, architectural patterns, and engineering reflections by Mohamed Amine Bchir.

item.title: What Our Tests Don't Prove
item.author: Mohamed Amine Bchir
item.description: Unit, spec, and contract tests provide evidence for changes, but operational readiness still requires risk-based load and recovery checks.

item.title: Deterministic Quality Gates for AI Code
item.author: Mohamed Amine Bchir
item.description: Deterministic quality gates let agents fix routine violations before review, so people can focus on behavior, design, and engineering decisions.

item.title: Contract Tests for AI-Generated Service Integrations
item.author: Mohamed Amine Bchir
item.description: Contract tests verify that services agree on APIs and message schemas, catching incompatible integrations and invented interfaces in AI-generated code.

item.title: Spec Tests at the Service Boundary
item.author: Mohamed Amine Bchir
item.description: Spec tests capture agreed service behavior in readable scenarios and run against the real application boundary, with examples and tooling across languages.

item.title: Unit Tests Are Dead. The Unit Moved.
item.author: Mohamed Amine Bchir
item.description: AI can change implementation and its tests together. Learn how to shift code review toward agreed behavior and validate AI-assisted changes with separate checks.
